# Avsnitt 197 – Varma återseenden

**Feed**: kvalitetsaktiepodden  
**Published**: 2026-10-21  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts of Kvalitetsaktiepodden (episode 197) worry that the market rally is narrow and AI-driven. Most Stockholm stocks have lagged the index, US consumer confidence is at a record low, and cracks are appearing in AI data-centre funding such as CoreWeave's falling bond prices. On companies, they welcome contract manufacturer Inission's raised 2026 sales guidance, discuss how a possible iGaming ban in Brazil hits Betsson, Evolution and Hacksaw, and explain why they avoid popular Twitter stocks like Chefello, Hacksaw, Nelly and the re-listing Prisjakt, using their five-year listing rule.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟡 INISS-B — Inission | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Hosts own shares and keep them. Guidance raised to SEK 2.5-2.6bn on better order intake; German acquisition uncertain.

#### Reasoning

Guidance raised about 6% at the midpoint on improved order intake, matching the hosts' own estimate. The cheap German buy from a bankruptcy estate (0.3x sales, low margin, sales expected to fall) is uncertain and brings back memories of a past failed deal. The hosts want answers at the Q3 call.

#### Sell Triggers

- German acquisition proves weak or loss-making
- Q3 conference call fails to justify the acquisition
- order intake weakens

> *"Vi äger aktier sedan ett bra tag tillbaka har vi pratat om tidigare. Det gör vi fortsatt."*

---

### ⛔ HACK — Hacksaw | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Growth slowed to 11-12% and the stock fell 28%. 83% margin seen as unsustainable; fails the five-year listing rule; management concerns.

#### Reasoning

Growth is slowing as operator coverage fills out. Slots are getting easier to make, so competition will rise and margins can only fall from 83%. The listing history is too short for the hosts' five-year rule, and management appears not to be fully in control. Hosts doubt Redeye's call for 30% growth to return.

#### Sell Triggers

- sustains high margins for five years after listing
- growth re-accelerates convincingly

> *"Och därför står vi fortfarande utanför Axo. Även om Leman har varit på besök. Det ska mycket till att jag ska in där ändå faktiskt."*

---

### ⛔ CHEF — Chefello | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Hosts do not invest: profitable history too short (losses in 2022) and the normal long-run margin is unclear. Q3 growth only 3.6%.

#### Reasoning

The story has been margin expansion to 8.6% rather than growth. Active customers rose only 5.5% in three years. Grocers like Axfood earn about 4%, so the hosts doubt how high meal-kit margins can go. Slowing growth is a worry. They do praise management.

#### Sell Triggers

- sustained margin history proving durability
- growth re-accelerates

> *"Vi tycker att den bra historiken är för kort. Det var förlust så sent som 2022."*

---

### ⛔ NELLY — Nelly | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Stock has not recovered and the CFO has left. Hosts say they will not buy it.

#### Reasoning

After the crash, more negative news followed and the CFO resigned. The hosts note bad news tends to keep coming once the story breaks. The Q3 report will be telling, but they explicitly will not buy.

> *"Men vi kommer inte köpa den."*

---

### 🟠 BETS-B — Betsson | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Claes holds a small watch position. Little Brazil exposure, low valuations, terrible sentiment; risk is the ban spreading in Latin America.

#### Reasoning

Avoiding Brazil limits the direct hit. The main risk is Argentina or Peru copying a ban, since those markets matter more to Betsson. Valuation is low but sector sentiment is very poor, and prediction markets also weigh on the sector. This is Claes's private view; the firm holds no iGaming stocks.

#### Sell Triggers

- Brazil ban seen as a success and copied by Argentina or Peru
- further regulatory tightening

> *"Jag har privat en del aktier i Evolution, lite i Kambi, bevakningspost i Bettan."*

---

### 🟡 EVO — Evolution | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Claes owns it privately. Brazil ban hurts given its São Paulo studio and 9% of sales from Latin America, but its games will still reach players in the black market.

#### Reasoning

More exposed to Brazil than Betsson, but players are likely to keep accessing its games after a ban (about 40% of play was already unregulated). Sector sentiment is very poor. This is Claes's private holding, not a firm position.

#### Sell Triggers

- Brazil ban upheld and enforced effectively
- bans spread across Latin America

> *"Jag har privat en del aktier i Evolution"*

---
